label: Frontend
blurb: UI work with a real browser. Screenshot → fix → re-verify, read the DOM, check breakpoints.
_note: Runs on the omp engine for its browser / inspect_image / lsp / ast_edit tools — the screenshot-verify loop needs real rendering, not a fetch of the HTML.
No `tools`: omp activates all 31 built-ins by default and its --tools covers built-ins only; leaving it unset keeps the full surface.
No mode-local skills: omp filters its own discovery and never reads a mode's skills/ dir (see docs/pi-modes-design.md). The discipline lives in SYSTEM.md, resident every turn.
